name: Ahmad bin Hassan
bio:
Ahmad's fascination with motorsport began during his university days, fueled by late nights spent tinkering with student-built race cars. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, he quickly found his niche, working his way up the ranks in various racing teams across Southeast Asia. Ahmad believes in a holistic approach to engineering, emphasizing the importance of collaboration between departments to achieve optimal performance.

He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to inspire his team to think outside the box. Ahmad's focus is on finding innovative solutions to complex problems, often drawing inspiration from unconventional sources. His goal is not just to improve lap times, but to push the boundaries of what's possible in motorsport engineering, always striving for a competitive edge through data analysis and cutting-edge design.

physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing glasses.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out notebook filled with technical sketches.
Has a peculiar habit of humming softly while deep in thought.
Insists on a daily cup of strong Malaysian coffee at precisely 10:00 AM.
